title: Answer from a Halted Configuration
statement: For any nondeterministic register machine, oracle, input, register valuation $v$, recorded answer $r$, natural number $N$, and Boolean value $b$, a length-$N$ choice sequence from the halted configuration $(\mathrm{none},v,r)$ leaves recorded answer $b$ if and only if $r=\mathrm{some}\ b$.
